capabilities: Parse ISO 8601 dates from watched frontmatter properties
Generate daily-note links and store them in a managed frontmatter property
Configure watched properties per note or globally
Exclude notes by folder or tag
Update relations per file, for all files, or automatically on frontmatter changes
extras: The README warns that the plugin expects full control over its managed relations frontmatter field and should not share it with other relationship-management properties.
intentEvidence: I created this plugin primarly for my personal use, as I couldn't find anything else to achieve this linking functionality.
motivation: The author built it for personal use because nothing else offered this linking functionality.
problem: Obsidian displays Date and Date & Time frontmatter properties but does not link them to the daily notes for those dates.

relations.evidence: (using the same file format as defined in the settings of the dailyNotes plugin)

summary: Date-property linker that creates frontmatter links from Date and Date & Time properties to their corresponding daily notes.
